newsitem.title: CANADA: Aur, Canada Tungsten to merge.
newsitem.headline: Aur, Canada Tungsten to merge.

text.p: Aur Resources Inc and Canada Tungsten Inc said on Wednesday that they have agreed in principle to a proposed merger of the two companies.

Under the proposed amalgamation of Canada Tungsten with a wholly owned subsidiary of Aur, Canada Tungsten shareholders will get one common share and one common share purchase warrant of Aur for each 4.5 common shares of Canada Tungsten.
Each Aur warrant will permit the holder to buy one common share of Aur for C$9.50 on or prior to June 30, 1997, the companies said in a joint statement.
Aur already owns 46.2 percent of Canada Tungsten.

Aur's common shares closed at C$8.30 on Tuesday, while Canada Tungsten's common stock finished at C$1.36. The companies said the deal represents a premium of 36 percent for Canada Tungsten shareholders.
Aur said it will issue 5.6 million shares to Canada Tungsten shareholders upon completion of the merger. It will boost Aur's total outstanding common shares to 66.5 million.
The proposed merger is subject to a fairness opinion on the terms of the deal, approval from Canada Tungsten's minority shareholders, and regulatory approvals.

The companies said details of the proposed merger will be mailed to Canada Tungsten shareholders during the week of November 18. A shareholders' meeting is scheduled for December 23 to consider the merger.
